olympics-2026-downloads-by-country-itemized-usa
Line graph of one media object, itemized by top elements and country. The media object takes the form of peer swarms in peer to peer networks over time, from week 1 to week n. The y-xis is the number of downloaders in millions. The x-axis is the week number of the sample, starting at week 1 and ending at or before week 26.
